title: Keeping track of The Current Thing
content:
September 26; it feels like only three things matter; would like to come back and revisit in 1, 3, 6, 12 montths to see how these things ended up unfolding.


1. Deficit / bond yields
 
France borrowing higher than Greece; US 5+ bond yields; central banks rising rates everywhere; of course linked to strait (inflation) so one might resolve the otther. 

2. Iran strait/energy 

Rumors of US banning diesel exports; would be tough for Europe as Russian diesel is unreachable. Gas is 2.2 euro liter in France. Don't really see how the strait reopens.

3. AI

hugging face incident, Anthropic IPO in discussion, Dario call to 'pace the frontier', opus 5.5 just launched. This is the one I'm least optimistic about being a 'current thing'; maybe it'll just be 'the thing' for the next decade and more. No plateau in capabilities in sight.
